reviews.title: Rethink Your Model
reviews.text: $70/yr for a Bible is crazy work. Yes, you may offer it differently but commodifying the word of God as done in this app with “celebrity” readers, ads that are a must listen, and no free version is antithetical to God’s will that we go to all the nations and preach. You guys provide  it free “preach” for 7 days and dassit. This is not it. I understand upgrades but the basics should be free. Period.

reviews.title: FRAUDULENT APP
reviews.text:
Did the free trial and immediately hated the app and cancelled everything. Now, a week later, I got 2 charges from Idaho and California each for $14.99, so $30 total. 

I went back into the app and it says I have no subscription, but yet my card was charged twice. What a scam! To request a refund you have to go through Apple. Do not get this stupid app or they will steal from you.

reviews.title: Disappointed, Deleted Immediately
reviews.text: I downloaded the app after seeing an IG ad. I have been trying to grow my relationship with God and thought this would be a great app. There was a brief survey at the beginning to “tailor your experience” which was nice, not too long. A few of the questions ask if you would want an ad-free experience, in which I chose maybe, and was immediately directed to a page offering a 7-day free trial or a monthly or annual subscription. Before I read the fine print I would have done the free-trial, but it said they charge a $10 activation fee after the trial plus the $15 monthly subscription. I tried to bypass the free trial by hitting the “X” only to be directed to pay for a “limited time offer” of a week ad-free for $6. After patiently waiting the minute (typical ad length), I hit the faint“X” again only to be directed to another “limited time offer” to pay $6 per month instead of $14. This page also had a note of payment being so the creator could do whatever and no way to click off of it so I decided to delete the app. I was looking forward to trying a new app to grow closer to God but don’t like feeling forced into a subscription before even trying the product. Yes, there was a “free-trial” but the activation fee is a third of the actual monthly subscription so is it really free ?
